name: Fouquet's Mykonos
positioning: Cycladic-style beach hotel of suites and villas on Paraga Beach, on the rocky southern tip of Mykonos
best_for: Travelers who want a suite or villa with a private pool by the sea
Beach lovers who want direct beach access and a ROKA Beach Club on site

facts.text: The hotel is located on Paraga Beach in southern Mykonos.
It sits on the island's rocky southern tip, between Paraga and Paradise Beach.
The hotel has direct access to the beach.
The architecture is inspired by Cycladic tradition, with clean lines and natural materials.
Depending on the category, suites offer a private pool, a jacuzzi or panoramic terraces.
The Two-Bedroom Bungalow Suite has a terrace perched right above the waves.
The Rock Villa has a panoramic terrace and sea access woven through the rocks.
The Paradiso Villa has seven bedrooms, a private driveway and its own pool.
The hotel has the Rock Spa.
The hotel has an infinity pool.
Éole serves Greek-Mediterranean cuisine all day, with a Pool Club facing the Aegean Sea.
Le Bar serves cocktails honoring Fouquet's destinations and a sharing menu, with a terrace.

highlights.text: The Paraga Room Private Pool, Sea View has a private terrace and a heated pool suspended over the open sea.
Terrace Bungalows are junior suites with a private terrace with sunbeds, steps from the water.
A private boat shuttle takes guests to explore neighboring beaches.
The Cyclades Villa sits at the hotel's furthest point and has a pool stretching across its entire length facing the open sea.
ROKA, the Japanese concept, runs the hotel's restaurant and Beach Club.

considerations.text: Getting there: flights to Mykonos take about 3 hours 20 minutes from Paris and 3 hours 50 minutes from London.
The ROKA restaurant and Beach Club are described as the vibrant heart of the hotel.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that places it among the most exclusive stays on the island.
